title: Devnet demonstration: independent receipt verification

knowledge_cards.title: Verify each finalized transition before confirming the outbox
knowledge_cards.summary: This second synthetic Devnet demonstration records the verification rule: the client and daemon must check the selected network, program owner, exact Receipt PDA, transition commitments and finalized transaction. The second transition must continue the first state root, and retrying an already anchored queue must not create duplicate submissions.
